verdict.rationale: Quo's own marketing documents a shared team number ("Share one number and stay aligned with your team"), plus call routing and custom ring orders that spread calls across teammates. Nothing in the pack covers presence/availability status, conversation assignment, or internal comment threads. missing for 10: presence indicators, conversation assignment/ownership, internal notes or threads on conversations, in-depth first-party docs on shared-inbox collaboration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
